summary: Tested customer sign-off on engineer reports end-to-end. Backend: new suite test_customer_signoff_jan2026.py, 16/16 passing. It covers the SVC GET signoff and site_contact, POST signature validation (missing name, missing image, invalid email, missing or blank unavailable reason, missing case_id, unknown case 404), the complete gate (400 before sign-off, and status stays unchanged), and sign then complete. It checks the service-report PDF text for name, email and date, and for 'Customer unable to sign' plus the reason. It also covers email_report:false, special characters in the signer name, the calibration certificate 'Customer sign-off' section, the BFPO signature, signoff, complete gate and job-sheet PDF (signed and unavailable), and the BFPO PPM complete with no signoff (400), an invalid signoff (400), and a valid signoff (200: svc_signatures row with ppm_service_id, case_id=None, and the certificate PDF shows the block). Background emails fire and fail gracefully on the invalid Resend key with no crash; the recipient is the signer, or the site contact when there is no signer email. Updated regression tests to post a sign-off before /complete; 4 pre-existing failures in 215dp are unrelated. Frontend (mobile 390x844): the SVC engineer Complete tab CustomerSignOffCard works: the placeholder shows the site contact email, toasts appear for no signature, no reason and bad email, unavailable/capture-instead toggles work, and signature is POSTed before complete, which then locks the job. The unavailable flow also completes. The BFPO JobDetail Complete panel works the same way: inline errors appear, and signature is POSTed before complete, which shows the recap. One minor UI bug.

minor.issue: If the case is still 'new' (not accepted), the state walk fails silently (ValueErrors swallowed). The endpoint returns ok:true with status 'new', sets completed_at, and still emails a 'Signed job sheet … has been completed'. This predates the change but now sends emails.
There is no assigned-engineer check (complete has one). Any org user can record a sign-off on another engineer's case.

Any historical svc_signatures row for the case satisfies the gate. A case reopened after a prior sign-off can be completed again without a fresh customer signature. Consider scoping to signatures after the last reopen or on_site transition.

email_signed_pdf is awaited inline (not a background task), so a slow Resend call blocks the response. There is no guard against completing an already-completed service, so repeat calls add duplicate signatures and documents. The contact comes from site.contact_email instead of resolve_site_contact.
signed_by_name and contact name go into the email HTML without escaping (HTML injection in outbound email). Use html.escape.
The asyncio.create_task(...) result is not kept, so the task can be garbage-collected before it finishes. Keep a reference in a set or use BackgroundTasks.

ui_bugs.issue: When the sign-off was recorded as 'customer unavailable', the read-only recap says 'No customer signature was captured on this job.' and does not show the reason. The branch only checks sig.image_data. It should render 'Customer unable to sign — {unavailable_reason}'. The signed recap also omits signed_by_email.

issues: The name, role and email inputs have placeholders only, no visible labels, so filled values like 'PTI' lose context.
The 'Capture a signature instead' button has no data-testid and neither toggle button has type='button'.
PPMServiceDetail doesn't pass `contact` to SignOffFields, so the PPM email placeholder never shows the site contact.
The name input placeholder shows the contact name ('Site Manager'), which looks like a pre-filled value. Consider 'Printed name (e.g. Site Manager)'.

action_items: Fix the locked recap in EngineerJobDetailV2 (~line 3705) so it shows unavailable sign-offs with the reason, and the signer email.
Add the assigned-engineer check to POST /api/svc/engineer/signature.
Escape the signer and contact names in the email_signed_pdf HTML.
BFPO complete: reject, or don't email, when the state walk fails to reach awaiting_sign_off/closed.
PPM complete: move the email to a background task, guard against re-completing, and use resolve_site_contact. Pass contact to SignOffFields in PPMServiceDetail.
Optional: scope require_signoff to sign-offs captured after the latest reopen.
critical_code_review_comments: In svc complete() the signature goes through outboxPost, but the fast path (completeAndSendInvoice) uses plain axios. Offline, the fast path fails instead of queueing. Acceptable, but inconsistent.
Recaptures leave multiple svc_signatures rows (latest wins). This is fine, but a failed complete followed by a retry posts the signature again.
EngineerJobDetailV2.js is 4333 lines and bfpo.py is 1587. Both are well over the 700-line guideline.

rca of the issue: Locked recap bug: the EngineerJobDetailV2 locked view renders the signature block only when sig.image_data is set. Unavailable sign-offs store image_data='' with unavailable:true, so they fall through to the 'No customer signature' branch.
